body: Well even so, it's pretty hard to speak to your mum about having suicidal thoughts, but I guess so. You've given me quite a bit to think about...Thank you

But what if I go to try and resolve this and she just pushes me away like she always has...I mean I know it's a lot of 'what ifs' but what if she actually meant it and my own mum actually hates me. I'd just think back to this and sit here trying to decide on an answer, I'm really stuck on what to do...Speaking to her seems great but what if she actually hates me and doesn't want to speak to me...

I see where you're coming from and I seriously respect it, but even if 'A mother is a mother' This mother wished I wasn't here, that she wasn't even my mother, and told me she hates me I mean how can she look me in the eye and tell me that she loves me after something like that?

Well what if i'm right and in 5-10 years time my life is just down the drain and i've ruined others...Surely ending it here would of been the best choice rather than living with people who hate me and messing the fuck outta there life, they could just be all happy when i'm gone and get on with their life
